newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's gold stocks hit by low bullion price.
newsitem.headline: Canada's gold stocks hit by low bullion price.

text.p: Canada's gold stocks took a beating on Thursday as the gold bullion price sank to its lowest level in more than three years.
The country's biggest gold company, Barrick Gold Corp, was down C$0.70 or 1.78 percent to C$38.55 while rival Placer Dome Inc was off C$0.55 or 1.83 percent to C$29.50.

Gold royalty company Franco-Nevada Mining Corp Ltd was one of the Toronto Stock Exchange's biggest losers by mid-morning, down C$1.75 to C$61. Its sister company, Euro-Nevada Mining Corp Ltd was off C$0.90 to C$40.
